items.summary: GLM-5.3-Flash runs on a single eight-GPU AMD Instinct™ MI300X node. The FP8 checkpoint is about 306 GB, roughly a fifth of the node’s 1,536 GB of HBM. During inference, most of the rest of the memory will be taken by the KV cache. The KV cache holds the attention keys and values of every token a request has processed, so the model does not recompute them at each decoding step. items.title: Accelerating GLM-5.2 on AMD Instinct MI355X: EvalScope Benchmarks with Prefix Caching
items.summary: GLM-5.2 combines a large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, sparse attention, and long-context processing. At long input lengths, this combination creates bottlenecks across GPU compute, memory bandwidth, and inter-GPU communication. Tuning a single kernel is not enough; the parallelization strategy, KV-cache layout, collective communication, kernels, and serving framework must be optimized together.
